notes.random: It is compared with 200 random-entry runs at its own time in market: random intraday trades, never overlapping and closed by the session's last bar, with lengths drawn from that strategy's own trades and the same share of longs, paying the same costs.
notes.val: Not a clean test. #6 was picked from the cb_bbkc_gc_v4_15m finalists using 2023–2024 results (Sharpe, beats-luck, stability, distinctness) as well as 2018–2022, so 2023–2024 is in-sample for the choice (the grid was fixed before any GC squeeze result). The untouched test is the 2025+ holdout tab.
notes.holdout: First squeeze-breakout look at the GC holdout. No compression-breakout strategy had been scored on GC 2025 onward before this. Only this one, frozen beforehand as part of a 5-strategy pick across RTY, CL and GC, was run (also scored by the funnel's final-test the same day), so there's no selection among holdout results. The mean-reversion family was scored on GC 2025+ earlier (different strategies), so the researcher has seen how that period treated it.

legs.settings_text: 15m bars, BB(25) inside KC × 3.5, at least 4 squeeze bar(s), wick entry, setup live 4 bar(s), stop at the box, no target, long + short, EMA(50) trend filter, any box width, flat at the close
